about: Known, accepted differences between original mode (labelA) and mirror mode (labelB). A rule applies to a page listed in pages, or to any page that loads one of datasets (DataHub keys). Optional conditions: requireA (field values in A that must all match), requireAGoogleSource (server meta endpoints that A's run saw pointing at Google; no source record counts as a match). Everything not covered here is reported as a real mismatch.

rules.reason: Stock: original-local reads the Google Sheet1 dump (17 Sep); mirror reads the Supabase Storage snapshot (30 Oct, what production shows). All stock numbers differ.
Power Map: mirror loads Supabase through /api/power-map/data; original loads the published Google sheet (about 3 values differ).
Briefing: original-local showed all zeros because report meta was read from the old project (fixed by serve-api 659c7a4). After that fix both modes must show the same real numbers.

Before serve-api's report-meta fix, original-local reads the Google fallback sheets for defective, disconnection, pending MC and load extension; mirror reads the Supabase Storage CSVs. With the fix both read the Storage CSVs, so a difference there is a real failure.
Power news hub: /api/news is a live external news feed cached in each server process (not mirrored data); two servers fetched at different moments return different story lists.
